lines.zh: 我鼻子上这只角，老早就有了。
lines.en: The horn on my snout came first.
Every step presses down hard.
The horn on my snout catches the light.
I lift my head and test the air.
I sweep the trees with my eyes.
I pass this way as a dinosaur.
I leave deep marks in the ground.
I know the rivers of the Late Jurassic.
My forearms are short and of little use.
I go around a stretch of marsh.
I stop and dip my head for a drink.
The grass closes behind me.
I turn and head upstream.
My pace is not fast, but it does not stop.
My tail sweeps through the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴替我把草扫平。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass flat behind me.
I halt by the water.
My teeth show along the jaw.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把头转向风吹来的方向。
lines.en: I turn my head into the wind.

lines.zh: 晚风吹着晚侏罗的林子。
lines.en: The evening wind stirs the Late Jurassic trees.
I sink low into the grass.
I breathe in and out.
Nothing else is moving.
I rub my neck.
My shadow has shortened under me.
I keep my eyes half closed.
This river bend is peaceful.
I step in the water once.
There is an old scar on my horn.
You are downstream of me.
I know you are alive.
I need not run, and you cannot flee.
I slowly square up to you.
Your armour is too thin.
I open my jaws so you can see the teeth.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell what is in your hand.
I press my neck down.
You step back, and I step in.
I roar at you.
My body tilted.
Blood seeps through my teeth.
I gave half a step of ground.
This wound does not stop me.
I swung my head.
My hide stopped some of it.
I square up again.
I have noted that.
There is meat.
Drop it on the ground and I will take it.
That smell is right.
Too small a piece.
I come forward slowly.
Hold it lower; I cannot reach.
Is there a second piece.
That is gone in one bite.
Keep your hand steady.
I grind in with my side shoulder.
You stagger backward.
My footing is solid.

lines.zh: 我的胸骨硬得像一堵墙。
lines.en: My ribcage is as hard as a wall.
The grass went down between us.
I turn my head to look at you.
I do not like being shoved.
Move aside quickly.
I bellow across the river.
Among my kind, we keep our own bounds.
This stretch is enough.
I come near, step by step.
I lower the horn on my snout.
Easy. Check the water first.
The river will keep flowing.
We guard this bend together.
The prints will remain.
Lead the way.
I lower my head and bite it up.
Crush it, then swallow.
There is bone in this.
I fish out what fell in the river.
I snap my head aside.
This is no meat at all.
I fling it away.
The smell of blood is strong.
It is stuck between my teeth.
Your feet shifted.
I turn my head.
The river is at your back.
My jaws have opened.
This is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，让角对准你。
lines.en: I drop my head and aim the horn at you.
I am ready.
Stand and do not run.
Not far now.
Your step, my step.
My shadow covers you.
You are retreating toward the river.
My stride quickened.
The damp air dulls my smell.
I go around upstream.
You can only run so far.
I measure distance in strides.
This wood has no way out.
I wait for you to slip.
Ten more steps.
One bite down.
My foreclaws hold you.
Teeth close, and bone cracks.
You are thrown to one side.
I wrench my head and tear.
That bite had full weight.
You guard high and leave the low open.
I draw my stride back.
Blood spreads in the river.
You have not gone down.
A shape rises on the riverbank.
I crush the mud at the water's edge.
The horn on my snout shows first.
The wood goes quiet.
The horn on my snout parts a clump of ferns.
The Late Jurassic mud is soft.

lines.zh: 河里的淤泥从爪缝里挤出。
lines.en: River mud squeezes out between my claws.
I lift my head and sweep a look.
My prints are deep.
The river runs around my feet.
I am here, and I brought my teeth.
I keep watch over this path.
I lower myself slowly.

lines.zh: 北美与欧洲都曾是我的家。
lines.en: North America and Europe were once my home.
The flame came, and I backed off.
My forelegs buckled on landing.
River water pours into my mouth.
The blast knocked me down.
Something is lodged in my flank.
This force goes into my bones.
The riverbank has no prey left.
Lightning struck, and my whole body clenched.
No river here, and no bank.
